lines.en: My plates clack with every stride.

lines.zh: 长枪扛在肩上，枪尖朝后
lines.en: Pike on my shoulder, point trailing.
I patrol along the wall.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩在同一道线上
lines.en: Each step falls on the same line.

lines.zh: 队里的人跟在半步之后
lines.en: The squad follows half a step behind.
My cape brushes the stone steps.
I round the corner tower.

lines.zh: 头盔压得很低，看不清脸
lines.en: My helm sits low. You can't see my face.
My shield rides slightly raised.
In the wind my armor turns cold and stiff.

lines.zh: 靴底在台阶上留了湿印
lines.en: Wet prints trail from my boots.
Heading for the next post.
Standing at rest, pike point in the dirt.
I rest the shield against my knee.
Scratches cross my visor.

lines.zh: 我把头盔往上推了一点
lines.en: I push my helm up a little.
I watch the campfire.
One more notch on the strap.
I count the merlons on the wall.
My throat is very dry.
A relief watch changes off in the distance.
Faction armor is thicker than village gear.
Wind worries the edge of my cape.
I wait for orders. I don't talk much.
My hand never leaves the haft.
The banner snaps overhead.
I raise a hand for you to halt.
Give me the password.
You didn't answer.
I turn the pike point forward.
This camp is ours.
Your armor isn't ours.
I look at you through my visor.
Behind the visor, only breathing.
I never ask your reasons.
One more step changes things.

lines.zh: 我举着长矛，不眨眼地看你。
lines.en: I hold my spear up and watch you without blinking.
Your hand is too near your weapon.

lines.zh: 我往侧边挪，让出半个身位
lines.en: I shift aside to leave you a shoulder's width.
That's not kindness. It's procedure.
I wait for you to choose.
Stand still. Don't move.
This is the last warning.
Now is the time.
My armor took it. It still hurts.
I step back, then snap back into line.
My shoulder goes numb from the shock.
My helm is askew. I set it right.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记住你的手
lines.en: Now I know your hands.
I bite down and stay silent.
Blood drips through a gap in my armor.
A squadmate calls my number.
If I can stand, I can fight.

lines.zh: 我的胸甲凹了一块，还能站。
lines.en: My breastplate is dented, but I can still stand.
I don't take gifts.
Regulations don't cover that.
Keep your hands where they are.
Whatever you offer, the answer's the same.
I answer to a banner.
Put that away.
I glance at it. That's all.
Bribe me and you'll be worse off.
Rule one: accept nothing.
Just walk away.
I hold my ground and press back.
Our armor clacks.
You shouldn't be this close.
I set my shield between us.
My footing doesn't waver.
Back off. Keep your distance.
I've noted where you stand.
My haft blocks you.
You touched my pauldron.
No shoving on post.
Not in camp.
My home is on the far side of the wall.
When this war is over.
Then I'll go see them.
She stitched this cape for me.
Crooked stitches, but they hold.

lines.zh: 我把她的名字刻在枪柄
lines.en: Her name is cut into my haft.
Touching it gets me through.
That's not weakness.
It's the reason I'm still alive.
I bend, using my free hand.
Into the pouch at my back.
One look and I toss it.
This isn't on the supply list.
Only the useful stays.

lines.zh: 我把箭捡起来，插回袋中
lines.en: I pick up the arrow and slot it back.
I have enough of these.
Safest to turn it in.

lines.zh: 我把它放在哨位的石上
lines.en: I set it on the post's stone.
Someone will collect it later.
Wrong password.
I level the pike.
Everyone at the post moves.
My shield's device faces you.
I take half a step and set my feet.

lines.zh: 队里的人在我身后排开
lines.en: The squad fans out behind me.
You have one way left to go.
Turn around at once.
I won't repeat myself a third time.

lines.zh: 城墙上的弓已经拉开了
lines.en: Bows on the wall have drawn.
No sudden movements.
I've started counting.
First warning.
Second warning.
I gave you time to leave.
No more time for you.
My pike stays on you.
You sidestep. I pivot.
I keep two paces of distance.
Shield to the front. No recklessness.

lines.zh: 队里有人绕到你的侧面
lines.en: A squadmate works around your flank.
I square my heels.
Your opening is on the right.
I'm waiting for it to widen.
The sand underfoot is loose.
I shift onto firmer ground.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸变快，我数得清。
lines.en: Your breathing quickens; I can count it.
That means you're about to move.
I'm fully ready.
The banner on the wall hasn't fallen.
We can still hold.
Not one inch.
This is our camp's ground.
And my faction's flag.
This belongs to my faction too.
Then make your move.
My pike thrusts at your chest.
You dodge, and my shield follows.
My haft sweeps your knees.
The point bites your armor.
I recover the pike and thrust again.

lines.zh: 步法很稳，没有多余动作
lines.en: Tight footwork. Nothing wasted.
You block it, and the shaft shudders.
My shield rim slams your shoulder.
The point skips past and cuts cloth.
No shouting. I just press forward.
The squad is rotating position.
Missed. I pull back.
You're faster than a fresh recruit.
Not enough yet.
I draw the pike back to load a thrust.
This one breaks your stance open.
I step aside and the pike comes low.
Plate grinds on plate at close range.
A new man takes the post.
My armor shows dark in the dawn light.
I plant the pike point in the soil.
I check every strap.
The banner goes up.
I lift my visor a touch.

lines.zh: 同队的人朝我点了下头
lines.en: A squadmate nods at me.
The wall's shadow covers me.
I take my assigned place.
Nothing to say.
Just hold the post.

lines.zh: 城墙上的号角响了两声
lines.en: Two horn notes sound from the wall.
I set a hand on my hilt without drawing.
My cape settles flat behind me.
I tighten my helm's chin strap.
This watch runs until dark.
The steps under me are worn smooth.
A smith's hammer sounds in the distance.
Fire makes my plates hot to the touch.

lines.zh: 落地的冲击穿过整条腿
lines.en: The landing shock runs up my whole leg.
Water fills my visor and I can't see.
The blast tears my shield aside.
An arrow slips a gap into my ribs.
My body inside this armor won't obey me.
Holding the pike hungry, my hands shake.
Lightning runs the length of my armor.
The ground beneath the wall is gone.
